comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: a claimed adult child born 2005 (20; a qualifying relative, not a qualifying child) unable to care for themselves — a Form 2441 qualifying person on the other arm: credit 600 (line 24 falls from 3,165 to 2,565 beside the smaller standard deduction and no child tax credit for a 20-year-old).
